assets.prompt: Edit this wolf paper-cut head into ONE independently articulated HEAD WITHOUT THE LOWER JAW. Preserve the original left-facing pose, eye, upper muzzle, black nose, upper teeth, ear, charcoal mane, red accent and cream cheek fur. KEEP the entire long cream NECK ATTACHMENT descending at the lower right, including its round joint hole, attached to the head. REMOVE only the movable LOWER JAW: the narrow cream chin strip running from the leftmost bottom lip toward the cheek, and the red interior that belongs to that movable lower jaw. The open space under the upper muzzle must be transparent after removal. Reconstruct the cheek/neck contour and any surface previously covered by the lower jaw into a clean complete anatomical head suitable for articulating a separate jaw. Neck belongs entirely to THIS head, not the jaw. Do not close the mouth by inventing a fused lower jaw. Faithfully preserve existing textured layered paper art, charcoal black ivory and muted red palette. One isolated component, no extra objects, no text, no exterior shadows or glow, genuinely transparent background. Preserve reference scale and placement as closely as possible, all silhouette within canvas.

Extract ONLY the independently movable LOWER JAW of this left-facing wolf into a SINGLE complete isolated game sprite. This is the lower cream chin strip forming the bottom border of the open mouth at lower left, together with its red inner mouth lining and appropriate lower teeth. Extend it backwards under the cheek to form a complete rounded jaw-hinge root that was hidden behind the cheek. It may include a few short layered cream fur tufts along its rear/bottom edge, matching the source texture. ABSOLUTELY EXCLUDE the long diagonal cream neck attachment and its round hole at the far lower right: that neck stays with the head. EXCLUDE skull, eye, upper muzzle, nose, upper teeth, ear and big black mane. Jaw should be a relatively shallow elongated curved lower-mandible shape, tip to the LEFT, hinge to the RIGHT; not an entire head and not a long neck. Complete occluded root naturally and cleanly. Preserve original cream charcoal and muted red textured paper style and left-facing open-jaw angle. One component only with ample transparent padding; no exterior shadows, glow, background, labels or extra objects. Genuinely transparent background.
